sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Release R-214 in week 9 hit reliability, cost and delivery. Payments has used {{K16:paymentsBudgetUsed}} of its error budget. MTTR peaked at {{K17:mttr:at(8)}} and is back to {{K17:mttr:last}}. Cloud cost rose {{K07:spikeW9}} ({{K07:spikeAmt}}) in week 9 and is still {{K07:vsW8}} above week 8.
The year is landing at {{K06:landing}} against a {{K06:fullYearPlan}} plan ({{K06:landingVsPlan}}). Year to date, spend is {{K06:budgetYtd}} over plan ({{K06:ytdActual}} against {{K06:ytdBudget}}).

sections.heading: Operations
paragraphs: {{K16:overBudget}} critical services are over their error budget. Payments availability is {{K16:paymentsAvailability}} against a {{K16:target}} target.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: Renewals due in the next 6 to 12 months: {{K09:renewals}}. The Observability platform (notice by 15 Nov 2026) and ERP licences (notice by 20 Dec 2026) carry price uplifts of 7% or more. Cloud waste is {{K07:wasteShare}} of spend.

sections.heading: Security and delivery
paragraphs: {{K20:criticalOpen}} critical vulnerabilities are open and {{K20:patchedInSla}} were patched within SLA against a {{K20:patchTarget}} target. {{K24:overdue}} audit findings are overdue.
{{K14:flagged}} of {{K14:total}} projects are reported Green but show risk signals. The Payments change fail rate is {{X01:changeFailRate}}.

sections.heading: AI
paragraphs: LLM spend is {{K35:annualised}} a year at the current rate. Measured benefit is {{K32:measuredValue}} a year, with another {{K32:estimatedValue}} estimated.

sections.heading: Notes
paragraphs: All figures are illustrative. The year-end landing is a trend-based forecast, not an approved one. Approval pending.
